item.title: Family of 42-year-old Ocala man who choked to death on piece of steak sues Disney restaurant
item.description: The family of an Ocala man has filed a wrongful death lawsuit against a restaurant at Disney Springs, alleging that a delay in summoning paramedics contributed to his death after he choked on a piece of steak. item.title: Marion residents share opinions about ICE in light of shooting in Minnesota
item.description: "I have no problem with protests, as long as they're done peacefully. Trying to run people and throwing objects is not a peaceful protest. If law enforcement is present, listen to what you are being told to do and obey what they are saying and no one will get hurt. If you don't, then what happens is on you." - Several residents have written in to share opinions about an officer-involved shooting in Minnesota that claimed the life of Renee Good. Read more: Marion residents share opinions about IC
